A1.justification: Both PDFs describe MetroGS and contain readable main text, equations, figures, tables, and supplementary Sections A–D. The complete material supports a reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original reconstruction and rendering experiments, component ablations, and efficiency measurements in Tables 1–6 and accompanying figures, including supplementary results.

after.justification: v2 retains these original empirical results, including the main benchmark comparisons, ablations, and supplementary efficiency and dataset evaluations.

M1.justification: The distributed 2DGS framework, structured dense enhancement, progressive geometric refinement, and depth-guided appearance modeling remain unchanged. The added attribution in the introduction does not alter the procedure described in Section 4.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate GauU-Scene, MatrixCity aerial and street views, and the supplementary Mill19 and UrbanScene3D scenes. No dataset, task, domain, or test scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: Comparator membership within Tables 1–6 is unchanged, including CityGSV2 and CityGS-X and the supplementary PGSR and PGSR+VastGS comparisons. The newly cited stereo papers are acknowledged as inspiration without being added to the evaluated baselines.

E3.justification: Section 5.1 and supplementary Sections A–C retain the same image resolutions, training budgets, batch size, evaluation metrics, view-embedding assignment, and TSDF extraction settings. No experimental protocol is added or revised.

E4.justification: The component ablations in Table 3 and Figures 6–7, training-efficiency analysis in supplementary Section C.1, and qualitative analyses in Section C.2 are retained. No new ablation, robustness test, or analytical question is introduced.

E5.justification: Both versions retain the same point-estimate reporting. Neither provides repeated-run or seed counts, confidence intervals, statistical error bars, or significance tests for these experiments.

E6.justification: All numerical result entries in Tables 1–6 are unchanged. For example, Russian Building retains 24.94 PSNR and 0.585 F1, and MatrixCity-Aerial retains 0.677 F1 for MetroGS. The qualitative examples and reported findings also remain the same.

T1.justification: Equation (6) changes 'maxs(s_i)' to 'max(s_i)', cleaning up notation for the same maximum-scale penalty described in Section 4.3.1. No substantive mathematical definition, assumption, derivation, or proof changes.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution list, and conclusion retain the same claims about dense enhancement, hybrid geometric refinement, appearance modeling, and efficient, accurate large-scale reconstruction. The new citations acknowledge inspiration without changing these claims' scope.

C2.justification: The interpretations of component effectiveness and training efficiency are unchanged. Supplementary Sections C–D retain the same discussion of model compactness, memory bottlenecks, and the rendering-quality limitations of using 2DGS.

D1.justification: The hardware, loss weights, densification thresholds, training schedules, baseline configurations, and extraction parameters remain unchanged. The project-page link and disclosures about using provided checkpoints are also retained.

R1.justification: v2 adds Bleyer et al.'s PatchMatch Stereo (2011) and Xu and Tao's Multi-scale Geometric Consistency Guided Multi-view Stereo (2019), explicitly identifying them as inspiration in the introduction. This is a limited attribution improvement; the existing references and broader research positioning remain.

P1.justification: v2 lightly rewrites the introduction's refinement description, adds a funding acknowledgment, changes the author name from Zhuxin Ma to Xinzhu Ma, and cleans up Equation (6)'s notation. Supplementary Section C.3 introduces the typo 'methodd'. The scientific section structure remains unchanged.

P2.justification: Figure 10 revises the red crop and inset borders while retaining the same examples; Figure 3 has minor raster-quality differences. The acknowledgment and added references cause limited text reflow. Table structures and figure placements remain unchanged.

improvement.justification: The introduction now explicitly credits two sources inspiring the existing PatchMatch refinement, improving attribution and traceability. Equation (6)'s notation cleanup adds a small clarity benefit. These limited improvements outweigh the isolated new appendix typo; the method, empirical evidence, and limitations remain unchanged.
